archetypes.name: dyn-oos-routing
archetypes.rationale: Review security-tagged OOS partitioning at the pre-vote gate.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed pre-vote OOS gate and voting classifier extraction. Check that security-tagged dropped OOS blocks cannot reach the public audit artifact or committed run logs, including mixed and all-security cases. Verify the public and local audit streams are independently renumbered and stale content is cleared. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-gate-regression
archetypes.rationale: Check pre-vote gate counts, env output, and ballot rewrite invariants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pre-vote OOS gate behavior for dropped counts, remaining counts, env-file contents, and findings.md rewrites. Confirm the status stays ok when all dropped blocks are security-local and skipped only when nothing is dropped. Look for regressions in restoration behavior if audit or ballot writes fail. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
